QuestInfo.name: Temporary Relief
QuestInfo.1: You met Captain Edmond in the year 2099. He wants revenge on the monsters that destroyed the Harbor, so he told you to bring him 20 #b#i4000548##t4000548##k items and 20 of #i4000549##t4000549##k items from defeated monsters.
QuestInfo.2: You met Captain Edmond in Year 2099. He wants revenge on the monsters that destroyed the Harbor, so he told you to bring him Radar Devices from the Overlords. You did so, but this is only a small comfort to him.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 468,451\nCan proceed to Taking Them Head-On quest\n
QuestInfo.0: #p2082008# seems to be displeased. What could have caused all this ruin?

0.0: Look here. The harbor has been entirely overtaken by monsters. The harbor represents the dream and dignity of the men of the sea, and I can't bear to just watch those monsters stomp all over that. I'm planning to drive them out. You seem young and capable. Why don't you help me, huh?

yes.0: If you observe these monsters, you can learn how they move. One thing we noticed was how they see using their Radar Devices. If we can get rid of those, they'll be practically helpless. Bring me 20 #b#i4000548##t4000548##k parts and 20 #b#i4000549##t4000549##k parts.

no.0: You're young, yet you lack determination and courage. Hmph.

1.0: So, these are the Radar Devices, huh? I can't wait to see those things fumble around without them!

item.0: Bring me #r20 Overlord A Radar Devices#k and #r20 Overlord B Radar Devices#k. It may not completely solve the problem, but it should improve things a bit.
